title: Open exports: HSDS JSON/CSV + GeoJSON + documented schema + effective-license/attribution statement
context: The export pipeline turns the internal HSDS dataset into openly-licensed, interoperable distribution files that 211 services, civic-tech builders, and map makers can reuse without bespoke glue. The ODbL share-alike constraint is critical: any export bundle that includes OSM-derived records must declare ODbL and OSM attribution; only permissive/PD-derived records can be exported under CC-BY. Incorrect license labeling on an export that includes OSM data is a license violation. Depends on food-maps-region-012 (a complete verified region).
objective: Build the export pipeline that produces: (1) HSDS-conformant JSON and CSV exports of the regional dataset; (2) GeoJSON export for mapping; (3) a documented schema (JSON Schema reference + field dictionary); and (4) an effective-license/attribution statement in the export bundle that correctly declares the license(s) per the ODbL resolution (ODbL for any OSM-derived records, CC-BY-4.0 for permissive/PD-only records) and required attributions including OSM. The export bundle is produced by CI on each release.
acceptanceCriteria: HSDS-conformant JSON export covers all published entries for the region with all required provenance fields
CSV export covers the same entries in a flat, human-readable format with field documentation
GeoJSON export includes all entries with coordinates and a subset of HSDS fields sufficient for mapping
A schema documentation file (JSON Schema reference or field dictionary) is included in the bundle

The effective-license/attribution statement correctly declares: ODbL-1.0 for any OSM-derived records (with '© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL' attribution); CC-BY-4.0 for permissive/PD-only derived records; and the full list of required attributions per source
No export bundle relabels ODbL-derived data as CC-BY
Export pipeline runs in CI on each tagged release and produces checksummed artifacts
A README in the export bundle describes how to use the data, the licensing constraints, and how to contribute corrections
output: src/pipeline/export.ts (export pipeline) + output/<region>/ bundle containing HSDS JSON, CSV, GeoJSON, schema docs, and the effective-license/attribution statement, generated by CI.
